purpose: Choose the final GP method from validation only, then run it on all five folds.
split: Train on folds 2-4, validate on fold 1, all 39 cell lines. Test-fold rows are never predicted in the study.
base_method: Kingsley Ukandu's GP (gaussian_process/src/project_utils.py): one model per cell line, drug identities and standardized log doses, rho 0.25, w 1, RBF vs Matern 5/2 per cell by validation RMSE.

predictors.exact: His exact GP on the capped training blocks.
predictors.inducing: Extension: his fitted hyperparameters and the capped blocks as inducing inputs, conditioned on every training row of the cell (DTC/VFE predictive, Titsias 2009).

metrics: Per method, pooled over cells using each cell's selected family: validation MSE (primary), RMSE, Gaussian NLL, 90% interval coverage, fit seconds, peak traced memory, convergence warnings, hyperparameters at a bound.
selection: Candidates are the his-kernel methods (w 1, rho 0.25): cap1500, cap3000 and cap6000 exact, and cap1500 and cap3000 inducing.
Eligible: estimated five-fold production cost <= 8 h wall on the local 8-core CPU, from the measured study seconds scaled by 5 folds and the worker count.
Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest pooled validation MSE. If a cheaper eligible candidate is within 1% of that MSE, choose the cheapest such candidate.

Kernel variants (w 0, rho 0, rho 0.5) are diagnostics. One replaces the default only if it lowers pooled validation MSE by more than 1% at cap 1500; it would then be validated at the selected scale before production.
Ineligible candidates are reported as validation-only results with their measured cost.
production: Selected method, all five folds, fold_<k>.parquet with observation_id, prediction and predictive_std.
